function: D-MoENN detects pilot spoofing attacks (user-number estimation) and localizes the eavesdropper's cell; precoding and AN jamming are closed-form, not learned (p. 1, p. 13).
notes: Reason function. p. 13: "we propose two neural networks, i.e., D-MoENN-PSA and D-MoENN-LOC to individually detect the presence of Eve and estimate the locating cell of Eve". PSA detection is attack detection (akin to physical-layer authentication), recast on p. 8 as "a user number estimation problem"; D-MoENN-LOC is localization, trained on "the label of the locating cell of Eve" (p. 10, eq. 29). Both are excluded functions. No learned component performs an area 1-3 function: channel estimation is least squares (p. 4), the MMSE-based LSFP is closed-form (p. 5, Proposition 1), the AN precoder comes from an SVD (p. 6), and the jamming BS follows a fixed rule, "selecting the nearest jamming BS to Eve" (p. 6; Algorithm 1, p. 10). Reviewer may confirm that this localization-driven jamming BS selection, evaluated by secrecy rate (p. 12, Figs. 10-11), is not area 3. Checks 1-4 pass: research article with learned detection and localization on received pilots in a multi-cell massive MIMO system.
